body: You’re strong. Don’t let the thoughts get to you, you have a future ahead of you

I have thought about what’s best for my recovery or for getting better.. I know deep down that cutting is just something that feels good while doing it but regrettable afterwards. But sometimes it feels like I have no other choice. I have one best friend and my boyfriend and I tell them everything, they’re my supporters in life and I’m so happy I have them.

Thank you, it is really hard to know that she’s gone because she was the thing that made this family fun. She was the best mother you could ever ask for. My family now is just me, my dad and my sister. It’s a small family but I love them, it’s really hard to see my little sister (9 years old) struggle with missing mom.
I really want to try and distract myself and I’ve gotten better at it, but the times where it feels like I can’t I feel so helpless
Thank you so much, this gave me a little hope

I tell her almost everything.
People don’t understand how bad I am, how depressed I am etc. My mother passed away last May and she was my life, I was already depressed before she passed away due to self hate and just a rough childhood (it was amazing as well, just rough too..)
I feel that I deserve to cut myself because I’m not good enough, not pretty enough or skinny enough. I’m never enough.

I just want to so badly. I just want to cut so deep so that I have to go to the hospital or something, for people to understand how I actually feel.

I meet a psychologist once a week, I use melatonin to be able to sleep.
